families.title: Crypto time-series momentum and Turtle trend

source.summary: Time-series momentum tests whether an instrument's own past return predicts its future return across markets.
source.citation: Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen, Time Series Momentum, Journal of Financial Economics, 2012.

families.mechanism: Persistent directional trends with volatility-scaled exposure and diversified risk.
families.formula: sign(lookback return) with Donchian confirmation and inverse-volatility sizing

families.title: Crypto pair relative value

source.summary: Pairs trading studies relative-price divergence and convergence using a predefined pair-selection rule.
source.citation: Gatev, Goetzmann and Rouwenhorst, Pairs Trading: Performance of a Relative Value Arbitrage Rule, NBER Working Paper 7032.

families.mechanism: Temporary divergence of a stable relative-value relationship followed by convergence.
families.formula: hedged residual z-score with half-life and structural-break controls

families.title: Conditional residual mean reversion

source.summary: The cited work studies return reversals after extreme prior performance; AlphaPilot treats it as a hypothesis rather than proof for crypto.
source.citation: De Bondt and Thaler, Does the Stock Market Overreact?, Journal of Finance, 1985.

families.mechanism: Residual dislocation can revert only under a preregistered range or liquidity regime.
families.formula: market-residual excursion normalized by robust volatility with frozen regime filter

families.title: Crypto cross-sectional factor ranking

source.summary: Cross-sectional momentum ranks assets by past performance and compares future returns of winners and losers.
source.citation: Jegadeesh and Titman, Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers, Journal of Finance, 1993.

families.mechanism: Relative return persistence across a point-in-time tradable cross-section.
families.formula: cross-sectional rank of lagged return with neutralization and turnover controls

families.title: Crypto event-driven public-data study

source.summary: OKX documents public market, instrument, funding, open-interest, and historical-data interfaces used to timestamp observable events.
source.citation: OKX API v5 documentation, public market data and funding-rate history sections.

families.mechanism: A timestamped public event can change funding, positioning, liquidity, or volatility conditional on causal availability.
families.formula: event-time surprise relative to a frozen pre-event baseline with embargoed entry

families.title: AlphaPilot Chan structure parser context

source.summary: An internal deterministic parser proposal for swing, segment, consolidation, divergence, and invalidation context.
source.citation: AlphaPilot Internal Technical Context: Chan structure parser v1.

families.mechanism: Deterministic market-structure context can label and rank setups without becoming a standalone discretionary signal.
families.formula: frozen swing and segment state machine with explicit invalidation
